enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Remain asleep. Turn onto back. Stretch arms. Turn to left side. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up face wash. Apply face wash. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, preparing a packed lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, milk. Close refrigerator. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Toast bread. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Prepare packed lunch: take out lunchbox. Assemble sandwich with lettuce, tomato, cheese, ham. Place in lunchbox. Close lunchbox. Put lunchbox in bag. Wipe counter. Turn off light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Walk to bedroom. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to facility. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients and completing clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Take vital signs. Administer medication. Assist doctor with procedure. Talk to patient: 'How are you feeling today?' Update patient records. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient cases. Take lunch break. Eat lunch in break room. Return to ward. Respond to patient call. Adjust IV drip. Talk to patient's family: 'The doctor will see you soon.' Complete clinical notes. Handover to next shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, cleaning up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Cook vegetables. Add spices. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Clear table. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put away dishes. Wipe counter. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Get up. Walk to bathroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Walk to bedroom. Put on pajamas.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer and watching TV for leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Open social media. Scroll. Watch TV. Change channel. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Close laptop. Turn off TV. Get up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime oral care and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed and falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Lie down on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes. Fall asleep.
